name: survival-llm-dev-tools
description: Optional formatting tools for the browser UI and project website

scripts.format: prettier --write "app/static/**/*.{html,css,js}" "docs/index.html" "docs/src/**/*.{css,js}" docs/.prettierrc package.json package-lock.json prettier.config.cjs ".vscode/*.json" local-tools/README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "app/static/**/*.{html,css,js}" "docs/index.html" "docs/src/**/*.{css,js}" docs/.prettierrc package.json package-lock.json prettier.config.cjs ".vscode/*.json" local-tools/README.md
